encounter.title: Combat pressure 5 — mini-boss (seed 1571)

phases.label: moved: direction becomes a resource, fresh attack window, opens with an interruptible cast

encounter.notes: EXP-010/EXP-010b provisional, not user-approved. Same board/phases/seed as EXP-009's mini-boss (medium 1571, E 4hp -> N 5hp +1 Rotate). Phase 1 unchanged since EXP-010 (interval 6, dmg 1: 4 phase-1 hits take exactly 4 turns, 0 unavoidable phase-1 damage). rotate.advancesTurn=false is Gemini's suggestion (relayed by the user), not a settled design decision. EXP-011 TUNING: phase 2 now opens in an interruptible CAST (interval 3, dmg 1) instead of a plain ATTACK timer of the same shape — EXP-010b's FOUND (spikes/arrow-core/EXP-010b-REPORT.md §6) proved that plain timer forced exactly 1 unavoidable point of damage on this board (phase-2's fresh window only gave 2 hits before interval 3 fired). With the cast model, a hit landed while the cast is armed cancels it outright (no damage) and the boss's next attack becomes a normal one: interval 4, dmg 1 (`interruptedAttack`). Both numbers (cast interval 3/dmg 1, post-interrupt normal interval 4/dmg 1) are minimally-adjusted provisional values, not a balance decision — interval 4 was the first value tried that lets minDamageToWin prove a 0-damage path exists (verified exhaustively, proven not budget-limited, at player HP 4/9/10). Verified: `npm run cli -- encounter encounters/cp-e5.json --player-hp 10` now reports 'no-damage path exists: YES', and the reported minimum-damage sequence still uses the granted Rotate (ccw) to get enough N-side supply before the interrupting hit — Rotate is not mechanically required for *a* win (a Rotate-free board-clear-alive win already existed pre-EXP-011, just not damage-free), but it is still what the proven clean path uses.
